title: Turbulence Rises in the Imperial Capital
next_chapter_hook: In the secret letter from the imperial emissary, Chen Ji discovered that his mother was not only still alive, but had also placed a hidden piece deep within the imperial court capable of overturning the three sects—and the activation condition for this hidden piece was intimately connected to the completeness of the Tianji Record.

text.content: Ten days. The fateful decisive battle with the Demonic Path commander arriving at the imperial capital left only ten days. The majestic outline of the imperial city gradually clarified in the morning light, the vermillion palace walls like congealed blood, reflecting this land about to be swept by a storm of blood and carnage. Chen Ji stood on the stone steps of the southern gate of the imperial capital, gazing at the Tianqing Sect banner fluttering in the wind, his lips slightly upturning. Ten years. From servant disciple to Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince, from atrash (waste) persona to the world-famous 'trash陈'—he had finally returned to this place where his mother had left with grievances, in yet another identity.

dialogue.content: (Murmuring to himself) Mother, are you watching? Your child has returned.

text.content: The guards at the city gate scrutinized the seemingly delicate young man before them, their gazes carrying a hint of contempt. 'Present your passage token to enter the city.' Chen Ji said nothing, merely retrieving a crystal-clear jade token from his sleeve—carved with the four seal script characters '太子太师' (Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince), emanating a faint spiritual energy fluctuation. The guard's face instantly turned ashen, his legs going soft as he knelt. 'I was blind! Please forgive me, Your Excellency!' The surrounding crowd stirred, countless startled gazes converging on Chen Ji—Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince? Wasn't that the rumoredtrash (waste) disciple of the Tianqing Sect?

dialogue.content: (The Inner Sect communication talisman vibrates, Su Qingyao's voice comes through) Chen Ji, you've arrived at the imperial capital? I received news—the Xuanwu Sect is making moves; they're impeaching you in court for identity fraud.
(A cold smile curves his lips) Identity fraud? They came faster than I anticipated. Don't worry, I'm prepared.

text.content: Above the imperial palace throne room, within the magnificent hall bristling with representatives from various sects and schools, the Crown Prince sat at the main seat, his expression impatient as he listened to the arguments below. The Xuanwu Sect's rebellious elder—Han Xuzi—stood in the center of the hall, his finger nearly jabbing Chen Ji's nose, his face full of arrogance. 'Your Highness the Crown Prince! This person is clearly atrash (waste) servant from the Tianqing Sect, not even having broken through Foundation Building—how could he possibly be the Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince? I see this is clearly someone forging an identity, intending to deceive His Majesty!' Many Xuanwu Sect disciples among the crowd joined in the commotion, their gazes toward Chen Ji filled with mockery and disdain, as if watching a clown.

Chen Ji stood motionless, neither defending himself nor showing anger. His gaze was calm to the point of being terrifying, like watching a group of overreaching ants. Seeing this, Han Xuzi grew even more triumphant, coldly sneering: 'What, lost for words? Waste is waste—even if draped in the finest robes, it cannot conceal the baseness in the bones! I suggest Your Highness immediately strip this person's fake identity and throw him into prison for interrogation!' The Crown Prince furrowed his brows, his gaze falling on Chen Ji with a hint of inquiry. Chen Ji finally moved. He slowly raised his head, and a cold gleam flickered in his eyes as he looked at Han Xuzi.

choice.prompt: The Xuanwu Sect Elder Han Xuzi publicly humiliated and provoked him, with the entire court watching—how should Chen Ji respond?

choices.text: Present ironclad evidence to crush them
choices.description: Publicly display the appointment edict personally granted by the Crown Prince and the imperial seal, forcing Han Xuzi to kneel and confess his crimes on the spot
choices.visible_cost: Reveal a portion of hidden trump cards
choices.visible_reward: Reputation +5, Xuanwu Sect loses face completely
choices.risk_hint: May provoke subsequent retaliation from Xuanwu Sect

text.content: Chen Ji unhurriedly retrieved a scroll of bright yellow silk from his sleeve—the appointment edict personally signed by the Crown Prince, bearing the vermillion imperial seal, the spiritual energy flowing within it making authenticity or falsity instantly distinguishable. 'Since Elder Han doubts this official's identity, perhaps you should first take a look at this?' His voice was not loud, yet it clearly spread throughout the entire hall.

dialogue.content: The edict is here, the seal is proof. Does Elder Han wish to claim that His Highness the Crown Prince is deceiving the sovereign? Or that the imperial scribes are blind, unable to distinguish between Foundation Building cultivators and ordinary mortals?

choices.description: Publicly expose Han Xuzi's old ties to the Demonic Path with a poisonous tongue, making him lose face completely
choices.visible_reward: Han Xuzi is publicly humiliated, Reputation +3
choices.risk_hint: The other party may act desperately

text.content: Chen Ji chuckled lightly, that laugh sounding particularly jarring in the silent court. Han Xuzi frowned: 'What are you laughing at?' Chen Ji shook his head, his tone carrying a hint of pity: 'I laugh at you, Elder Han—being a sect elder, you haven't even done the most basic investigation before making wild accusations in court.' He paused, his gaze sweeping across the group of Xuanwu Sect disciples behind Han Xuzi: 'Could it be that Elder Han has been fraternizing with the Demonic Path for so long that you've forgotten how a normal person's brain works?'

dialogue.content: Elder Han met with the Demonic Path emissary at the ruined temple outside the city three days ago for a full hour—that blood-patterned jade pendant at that emissary's waist doesn't look like something an ordinary demonic cultivator could possess. Does this official need to be more specific about the time and location?

choices.text: Secretly keep trump cards in reserve
choices.description: Pretend to show weakness, let Han Lie grow even more arrogant, wait for him to reveal greater flaws before delivering a fatal blow
choices.visible_reward: Han Lie reveals more evidence, allowing us to uproot everything later
choices.risk_hint: If Han Lie has strong backing, things could backfire

text.content: Contrary to everyone's expectations, Chen Ji actually lowered his head, voice trembling slightly: "Elder Han is right... I really am a servant from the Tianqing Sect, undeserving of this position..." His shoulders trembled slightly, looking as if he was suppressing humiliating tears. The court erupted in uproar, the Crown Prince frowned. Su Qingyao watched from the crowd, a hint of confusion flickering in her eyes - from her understanding of Chen Ji, he would never yield so easily. Indeed, as Chen Ji kept his head bowed, a cold smile tugged at the corner of his mouth. His peripheral vision caught a disciple behind Han Lie, whose hand was stealthily reaching into his sleeve, as if to retrieve something.

dialogue.content: (Whispered, only to himself) The hook is set.

text.content: Seeing Chen Ji did not refute, Han Lie thought he was心虚 (guilty), growing even more triumphantly arrogant. He stepped forward, nearly face to face with Chen Ji, looking down condescendingly at this "waste": "What? Too afraid to speak? I knew it - someone who crawled out of the mud, even if he accidentally gained some fortune, is nothing but a monkey playing dress-up! Today, in front of His Highness the Crown Prince, I will expose you as a fraud who deceived the world—" Before he could finish, hurried footsteps sounded outside the hall. A servant tumbled in, falling to his knees: "Your Highness! The Imperial Envoys request an audience outside the hall!" The court fell silent instantly, all eyes turning toward the hall entrance. The arrival of Imperial Envoys at this moment was no coincidence.

The Crown Prince waved his hand: "Admit them." The hall doors slowly opened, and a procession of elegantly dressed figures entered in succession. At the head was a middle-aged man with an imposing presence, the Jade Pendant at his waist signifying his status as an Imperial Envoy. However, Chen Ji's gaze did not fall on him - instead, it was fixed on a figure at the end of the procession - an elderly woman with gray hair, wearing plain cloth clothing, but possessing eyes strikingly similar to Chen Ji's mother's. Chen Ji's heart tightened violently. It was Nurse Li - his mother's former personal attendant! When his mother disappeared ten years ago, Nurse Li vanished along with her, and everyone assumed she had met an untimely end. Yet here she was, appearing among the Imperial Envoys!

dialogue.content: (Shocked inside, yet maintaining composure) Nurse Li... how could she possibly...

text.content: The Imperial Envoy bowed to the Crown Prince, then scanned the surroundings before his gaze finally landed on Han Lie, a meaningful smile curling at his lips: "This Envoy has come today, besides传达皇命 (delivering the Imperial Decree), to report another matter to His Highness." He paused, his voice turning cold: "This Envoy has received definitive intelligence that Xuanwu Sect Elder Han Lie colluded with the Demonic Path, intending to dismantle His Highness's forces from within before the Demonic Path commander arrives. The evidence is conclusive, with both human testimony and material proof." Han Lie's face instantly turned ashen, cold sweat dripping from his forehead. "You... you slanderer!" he yelled, his bravado hollow. The Envoysneered (coldly smiled), pulling a stack of documents from his sleeve: "Slander? Then what is this? Correspondence between Elder Han and three secret liaison points of the Demonic Path, plus your privately kept Demonic Path token - the Blood-Pattern Jade Pendant. Elder Han, would you like this Envoy to display them publicly?" The court exploded. Those who had just been mocking Chen Ji now looked at Han Lie in terror, as if gazing upon a dead man.

Han Lie's face was ashen, his legs turning to jelly as he collapsed to the ground. He never imagined that his carefully laid trap would not only fail to bring down Chen Ji, but would instead bring about this public exposure by the Imperial Envoys. And the mastermind behind all this was precisely the "waste" in his eyes. Chen Ji watched the scene quietly, his eyes showing nofluctuation (fluctuation), as if everything was within his expectations. He slightly tilted his head, exchanging a glance with the Imperial Envoy - a look only the two of them understood. Ten years ago, before leaving the capital, his mother had already planted this piece on the board within the court. Ten years of waiting, all for today's fatal strike. The Crown Prince slammed the table and rose: "Guards! Seize Han Lie and interrogate him thoroughly!" The guards swarmed forward, dragging the limp Han Lie away. Murmurs filled the court, countless gazes converging on Chen Ji - some reverent, some terrified, and more than a few deeply wary. This young man was far from simple as he appeared.

choice.prompt: Han Lie was seized publicly, and the Xuanwu Sect suffered a heavy blow. At this moment, the Imperial Envoy was about to announce another major matter - news regarding Chen Ji's mother. How should Chen Ji respond?

choices.text: Take the initiative to control the narrative
choices.description: Speak before the Envoy, seize the initiative first, letting everyone know this was a backup plan left by his mother, not external assistance
choices.visible_cost: Expose the connection with his mother
choices.risk_hint: May attract attention and targeting from more forces

text.content: Before the Imperial Envoy could speak, Chen Ji stepped forward first. His voice was clear and unassuming: "Your Excellency, please wait." The Envoy paused, then smiled: "What does Lord Chen wish to say?" Chen Ji surveyed his surroundings, his gaze calm and open: "Your Excellency's exposure today of Han Lie's crimes of treason and collusion with the Demonic Path, Chen Ji is deeply grateful. But Chen Ji wishes to explain one thing before everyone present." He took a deep breath, his voice echoing through the grand hall: "Ten years ago, my mother left the capital under false accusations. Before she departed, she left behind words - if Chen Ji ever returned to this place one day, the backup she prepared would appear to assist. Today's events are merely a casual move my mother placed many years ago. Chen Ji does not dare claim sole credit."

dialogue.content: Everyone was shocked. A setup from ten years ago, yet it could precisely activate today? What kind of figures were this mother and son from the Chen family?

choices.text: Watch quietly and adapt to the circumstances
choices.description: Let the Envoy announce the news first, express surprise and emotion, building an image of someone who values feelings

text.content: Chen Ji did not speak, merely standing silently in place, his face appropriately showing几分 (a touch of) surprise and emotion. The Imperial Envoy understood, continuing in a loud voice: "This Envoy has another announcement - after years of investigation by Imperial Secret Agents, it has been confirmed that Chen Ji's mother did not defect, but was framed and forced to hide her identity. More importantly, she is still alive!" At this declaration, the entire court erupted. Chen Ji's body trembled slightly, the tremor perfectly conveying a son's shock and excitement upon hearing news of his mother's survival. He lowered his head, as if suppressing surging emotions. "Mother... is still alive?" His voice carried traces of choking, yet he strived to maintain composure. Su Qingyao watched his profile in the crowd, her heart stirring slightly - at this moment, Chen Ji looked so vulnerable yet real.

dialogue.content: (Inner thoughts) The acting is good, but for Nurse Li to appear at this moment, it means Mother's situation may not be optimistic...

choices.text: Secretly probe the emissary's true intentions
choices.description: Use the Tianji Record Fragment to glimpse a moment of the future, confirming the emissary's true purpose and Mother's true situation
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate consumption may bring backlash

text.content: Just as众人议论纷纷之际，陈机的右手悄悄触碰了怀中的天机录残页。一阵熟悉的眩晕感袭来，三时辰后的画面如潮水般涌入他的脑海——特使在私下密室中与李嬷嬷对话："夫人交代的任务已经完成，接下来就看少主自己的造化了。"画面一转，一个模糊的身影出现在某处禁地之中，那身影的轮廓，与记忆中母亲的模样惊人相似。她被困住了，而且困住她的，正是……陈玄当年留下的restriction！陈机猛地睁开眼睛，眼中闪过一丝horrified。母亲不仅活着，而且被封印在某处与天机录相关的地方！这一切的背后，远比他想象的要complex得多。

dialogue.content: (Inner thoughts) Mother... So you have always been within the causal karmic web of the Tianji Record. I must find a way to break the seal as soon as possible.

text.content: After the court session ended, Chen Ji went alone to the side hall. Nurse Li was already waiting there. After ten years of separation, her hair had turned completely white, but her eyes remained clear. "Young Master." She knelt trembling, her voice carrying a sob. Chen Ji quickly helped her up: "Nurse Li, please rise. All these years, you have suffered." Nurse Li shook her head, taking a small brocade box from her bosom: "This is what the Madam asked this old servant to give to the Young Master before she left. She said to hand it over only after the Young Master had established a firm footing in the imperial capital." Chen Ji took the box and opened it. Inside lay a warm jade-like token, engraved with a phoenix spreading its wings, forming a subtle echo with the imperial dragon token. "This is..." Chen Ji furrowed his brows.

dialogue.content: (Nurse Li explained in a low voice) This is the Phoenix Guard token. The Madam was not only of imperial blood, but also one of the founders of the Phoenix Guard organization. The Phoenix Guard is the most covert force in the dynasty, answering only to the token holder. After the Madam left, the Phoenix Guard has been lying in wait in the shadows, awaiting the Young Master's emergence.

text.content: Chen Ji held the token, his heart churning with indescribable emotions. His mother's identity was far more complex than he had imagined. She was not only a member of the Chen family, but also had countless connections to the imperial family, even creating the most secretive force in the dynasty. And all of this had been set in motion before he was even born. "Nurse Li, where is my mother... now?" Chen Ji finally asked the most crucial question. Nurse Li's expression darkened: "The Madam is trapped in an ancient forbidden land. That forbidden land is closely connected to the Tianji Record. Only by gathering all the fragments of the Tianji Record can the method of entry be found." Chen Ji's fingers tightened slightly. The fragments of the Tianji Record... He currently only had three pages in hand, but the complete Tianji Record consisted of nine pages. This meant he had to accelerate the pace of collecting the fragments. "The Demonic Path commander arrives in ten days," Chen Ji said gravely, "Before then, I must first stabilize the situation in the imperial capital." Nurse Li nodded: "Young Master, please rest assured, the Phoenix Guard stands ready to receive orders at any time."

Just then, a report came from outside the hall: "Su Qingyao requests an audience." Chen Ji put away the token and signaled for Nurse Li to withdraw. Su Qingyao walked in gracefully, her gaze sweeping across the side hall before finally landing on Chen Ji's face, carrying a hint of scrutiny. "You knew the imperial emissary would come long ago?" she asked directly. Chen Ji smiled: "I knew a little." Su Qingyao snorted coldly: "You certainly hide your cards deep. The imperial emissary publicly announced matters about your mother, and the entire imperial capital is about to explode. Do you know how many eyes will be watching you from now on?" Chen Ji walked to the window, gazing at the sky outside: "I know. But this is exactly what I need." Su Qingyao furrowed her brow: "What kind of game are you playing?" Chen Ji turned around, his gaze profound: "Qingyao, in ten days the Demonic Path commander will personally arrive, and the world will be thrown into chaos. Before then, I must clear away all unstable factors. The Xuanwu Sect, the imperial family, even... the Eye of Heavenly Dao." Su Qingyao's body stiffened slightly: "The Eye of Heavenly Dao? What are you—" Chen Ji raised his hand to interrupt her: "Some things are not yet the time to say. You only need to know that a grand drama is about to unfold in the imperial capital."

dialogue.content: (Su Qingyao gazing at him) Chen Ji, I've always wanted to know, what am I to you? An investigation target? A business partner? Or...

(Looking at her seriously) Qingyao, you are one of the people I trust most. So there are some things I cannot tell you, not because I don't trust you, but because the more one knows, the greater the danger.

text.content: Su Qingyao was silent for a moment, then finally sighed softly: "Fine, I know I can't get anything out of you. However..." Her tone suddenly became serious, "Whatever happens next, I will stand on your side. Not because you are the Grand Tutor to the Crown Prince, but because..." She paused, as if weighing her words, "You are Chen Ji." Chen Ji looked at her, warmth surging in his heart. In this world of scheming and deceit, how rare it is to have someone stand by your side without hesitation. "Thank you." he said softly. Su Qingyao turned and left, but paused at the door: "By the way, I've heard some news about your sister Chen Nian. She seems to have been taken by the Holy Sect to a certain forbidden land in the Northern Territory. The specific location is still being traced." Chen Ji's gaze instantly sharpened: "Keep investigating. The moment you have news, inform me immediately." Su Qingyao nodded and disappeared outside the hall.

Night fell, and the countless lights of the imperial capital gradually lit up. Chen Ji stood atop the palace, overlooking this massive and complex city. Ten years of layout, finally beginning to bear fruit on this day. However, this was merely the beginning. The Demonic Path commander's arrival, his mother being trapped, the watch of the Eye of Heavenly Dao, Chen Nian's whereabouts... all the clues pointed in one direction—the upcoming battle of destiny. He took out the Tianji Record fragment from his bosom, the runes on it glowing with a faint light under the moonlight. Mo Xiansheng's voice echoed in his mind: "Young Master, the Phoenix Guard your mother left behind is a force not to be underestimated. But more importantly, she seems to know the true secret of the Tianji Record. Finding her may be the key to unraveling all these mysteries." Chen Ji tucked the fragment back into his bosom, his gaze fixed on the dark horizon to the north. Ten days. Only ten days. He had to make all preparations within these ten days. Because this time, he was fighting not just for himself, but for those he cared about. His mother, his sister, and all those he had drawn into this chess game. He slowly closed his eyes and took a deep breath. The winds and clouds of the imperial capital were just beginning. And he, Chen Ji, would surely write his own legend amid these storms.
